_comment: GRAZING TEST CONFIG (v2). GrazingCountsAsFeeding is ON. GraceHours 24 is well above the sheep graze cooldown (1-4 in-game hours) so a sheep with forage is guaranteed a chance to graze and reset its clock before starving. Expected result: a sheep on grass/tallgrass survives indefinitely (you'll see it graze); a sheep walled onto barren stone/dirt with no forage starves at ~24 in-game hours.
